name: MedMNIST v2: Large-Scale Lightweight Benchmark for Biomedical Image Classification
description: MedMNIST v2 is a standardized collection of 18 lightweight biomedical benchmarks (12 2D and 6 3D datasets) comprising 708,069 pre-processed biomedical images across modalities including X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, and pathology. Pre-processed into 28x28 (and 28x28x28) formats for rapid ML prototyping and educational benchmarking. Safeguard notice: Standardized educational and algorithmic benchmark; strictly not approved for clinical diagnostic utility or patient triage.
